title: World Bloom — To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage — Episode8 Training With a Friend!

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage
meta.Event Outline: On MORE MORE JUMP!'s first free day in quite some time, they have been enjoying school life to the full. Their recent TV appearance has caused a buzz among their classmates, renewing their determination to keep working their hardest. That's when they each find themselves in an unfamiliar part of SEKAI...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And pose!
How do I look?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But you lost balance there for a split second, so try to stay on axis when you go to pose...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
Airi even told me just the other day that my core still needs a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, Miku, let me try that again!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But you've been at it for close to an hour and a half now. Why don't you take a quick break first...?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
I completely lost track of time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... I was hoping that you'd watch me practice interacting with an audience afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You have a really good work ethic, but it seems odd for you to be trying this hard...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So... It has to do with something that happened during our last TV shoot...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<TV shoot...?
Oh, do you mean for Mr. Arimura's show?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. You watched it, right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Audience Member A
rows.Line:
So, where'd the original guests go?
Why is MORE MORE JUMP! or whoever here instead?

rows.Speaker: Audience Member B
rows.Line: But I still wish LiLia were here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After I overheard what those audience members were saying, even though I knew that we couldn't make up for not being LiLia, I decided that I was going to make sure they got to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I also feel that I could've done more for them during the first half of our shoot. If only I'd realized sooner...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why, even though I still have a lot to learn, I want to become a fully-fledged idol as fast as I can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, I'll be more than happy to help you!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes!
While we're at it, why don't we train together in SEKAI once we're done taking our break?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm sure it would be better if you practiced imagining talking to an audience while on a real stage.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
That'd definitely feel more like the real thing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was a good practice...!
Plenty of dancing and interacting with an audience! I feel a lot more confident now! Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You feel more confident because you put in the work, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You even came up with some nice ideas for making things fun. I hope you get a chance to use them during your next shoot...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
I can't wait for our next one♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't things seem a little too quiet around here today?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, come to think of it, I haven't seen anyone else here since we began practicing. We were at it for quite a while too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Where do you think everyone's gone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... MEIKO and KAITO said they were going over to see Haruka, but they should be back by now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That path over there...
I don't think I've ever seen it before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Hey, you're right...
I've never seen this before either.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do you think the others are wherever this path leads to?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's see where it takes us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay. I'm a little scared...
But, I also kinda want to know where it goes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For now, let's go take a quick look!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Oh, that looks like a stage way over on the other side, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, this vast field of flowers is so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought I just saw a shadowy figure just now. Of a little girl...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
B-But I don't see anything...
Maybe it was something else?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
M-Maybe.
But given where we are, what else could it have been...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think she ran this way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That voice...
Is it coming from this flower...?

rows.Speaker: Flower's Emitted Voice
rows.Line:
No, I still can't get it right...
If only...I could...be more like...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm having trouble making out what it's saying...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try moving a little closer and...
